top_signals.title: Bessent Risks Higher Yields If He Axes 20-Year Bond, BNP Warns

top_signals.title: Greg Abbott to Skip San Antonio Trump Rally Amid Tight Race
top_signals.summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott is planning to skip a political rally in San Antonio headlined by President Donald Trump, declining a chance to appear with the country’s highest-profile Republican as his reelection bid faces a surprisingly strong challenge from Democrat Gina Hinojosa.
